run_profile_train: run the profile training script to profile a diplomacy model using ParlAI's standard training loop
run_profile_train_with_args: run the profile training script with custom argparse flags to profile model performance on diplomacy tasks
register_all_agents: call register_all_agents to import and register all diplomacy-specific agent modules with ParlAI
register_all_tasks: call register_all_tasks to import and register all diplomacy-specific task modules with ParlAI
review_profile_train_entry: review the profile_train entry point that wires diplomacy agents and tasks into ParlAI's ProfileTrain loop
